### GRE Quant 5-Week Study Schedule

This structured plan is designed for the GRE Quantitative Reasoning section, leading up to your test date on August 30, 2024. The schedule allocates 90 minutes on weekdays and 3 hours on Saturdays, with Sundays for rest. Each week focuses on a core topic area, culminating in a final week of intensive practice.

### Weekly Breakdown: July 29 - August 29

**Week 1: Arithmetic Foundations (July 29 - August 3)**
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/c1/Number-line.svg/1280px-Number-line.svg.png Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/hash.svg
- **Focus:** Master the building blocks of GRE Quant. Cover number properties, integers, fractions, decimals, percentages, ratios, and proportions.
- **Weekday Plan (90 min):** 60 minutes for concept learning and formula memorization; 30 minutes for targeted practice problems.
- **Saturday Goal (3 hrs):** Take a timed 45-60 minute quiz on all Arithmetic topics, then spend the remaining time reviewing every question, especially your mistakes.
Action: [Button: Practice Arithmetic] https://www.khanacademy.org/math/arithmetic

**Week 2: Algebra & Coordinate Geometry (August 5 - August 10)**
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/13/Quadratic_formula.svg/1200px-Quadratic_formula.svg.png Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/x-lg.svg
- **Focus:** Algebraic manipulations, equations, inequalities, exponents, roots, functions, and word problems. Introduce coordinate geometry concepts like lines, slopes, and quadrants.
- **Weekday Plan (90 min):** 60 minutes on algebraic concepts and strategies; 30 minutes applying them to GRE-style questions.
- **Saturday Goal (3 hrs):** Complete a timed quiz covering Algebra and basic Coordinate Geometry. Analyze your problem-solving process and speed for each question.
Action: [Button: Practice Algebra] https://www.khanacademy.org/math/algebra

**Week 3: Geometry (August 12 - August 17)**
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/e8/Pythagorean_theorem_demonstration.svg/1200px-Pythagorean_theorem_demonstration.svg.png Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/triangle-fill.svg
- **Focus:** Deep dive into shapes and their properties. Cover lines, angles, triangles, quadrilaterals, circles, polygons, and 3D solids (cubes, cylinders).
- **Weekday Plan (90 min):** 60 minutes memorizing geometry rules and theorems; 30 minutes on practice problems, focusing on visual and spatial reasoning.
- **Saturday Goal (3 hrs):** Take a timed quiz focused solely on Geometry. Use the review time to create flashcards for any formulas you forgot.
Action: [Button: Practice Geometry] https://www.khanacademy.org/math/geometry

**Week 4: Data Analysis & Mixed Review (August 19 - August 24)**
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/88/Misleading_y-axis_in_a_line_graph.png/1024px-Misleading_y-axis_in_a_line_graph.png Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/bar-chart-line-fill.svg
- **Focus:** Data interpretation from graphs, charts, and tables. Cover statistics (mean, median, mode, standard deviation), probability, and combinatorics (permutations, combinations).
- **Weekday Plan (90 min):** 60 minutes on data and probability concepts; 30 minutes on mixed problem sets that include topics from previous weeks.
- **Saturday Goal (3 hrs):** Complete a timed quiz with a heavy emphasis on Data Analysis but also including questions from all four topic areas to simulate test variety.
Action: [Button: Practice Data Analysis] https://www.khanacademy.org/math/statistics-probability

**Week 5: Final Review & Practice Tests (August 26 - August 29)**
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/e4/Computer-based_testing.jpg/1280px-Computer-based_testing.jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/stopwatch-fill.svg
- **Focus:** Building stamina and refining test-day strategy. This week is dedicated to full-length, timed practice exams.
- **Plan:** Take a full-length PowerPrep test on Monday and Wednesday. Use the 90 minutes on Tuesday and Thursday for in-depth review of the previous day's test, focusing on pacing, errors, and strategy.
- **Final Day (Aug 29):** Light review of key formulas and concepts. Do not take a full test. Rest well and ensure you are prepared for test day.
